name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.27.1: make a machine's model visible and a failed edit audible, after 8626020623 kept showing bays instead of a planogram. GET /api/v1/debug/commands now also reports model, isFridge, isKioskModel and known. That endpoint needs no login, so it is the one way to see what the BACKEND believes about a machine from a phone, rather than a dashboard that may be rendering a stale local copy - and model is what decides fridge-ness, so it is the first thing to check when the layout is wrong. Its configVersion, which touchConfig bumps on every successful update, tells you whether an edit ever landed. Second, the machine edit path used to skip the PUT entirely when backendOnline or API_TOKEN was falsy, update DB in place and still toast 'Machine updated'. Since hydrateMachinesFromBackend drops anything the backend does not return, that edit was undone on the next refresh and absent on every other device, while looking on screen exactly like a save that worked - the same shape of bug as the add path fixed in v6.27. It now refuses and says the backend was unreachable. Cumulative over v6.27.0.
